message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: a public official (公寓主任) used position to embezzle public funds (贪污). Two parts: 1) misappropriation of funds from account (private funds) 64000, personal gain 25500. 2) using procurement, falsifying invoices, defrauding public funds 15350, personal gain. Total 79350, personal 40850. So crime is 贪污 (embezzlement) by public officials. In Chinese criminal law, "贪污罪" is for state employees. So answer: [罪名]贪污<eoa>. Possibly also "受贿"? No, it's embezzlement, not receiving bribes. So single crime.
